Rule: scheduled service, an IATA code, and OurAirports type large_airport; plus medium_airport everywhere except in US, CA, CN and IN, where medium airports are kept only in the first-level regions with researched places (US: AK AZ CO MA NH NY UT VT WA WY; CA: AB BC ON QC; CN: 44; IN: SK). Countries: every country with researched places (AR CA CH CN FR IN IS IT US VN) plus the neighbouring gateways AT, CL and DE.
